title: salesorderedit.completed v1
description: A sales order header was edited through the admin edit surface (PUT /api/admin/sales-orders/<id>). Carries the per-field diff that landed. Aggregate: sales_order. A status transition to SHIPPED on the same edit additionally emits ship.confirmed via record_ship. sales_order_external_id carries the source-system identifier when one exists (cross_system_mappings), falling back to the Sentry canonical UUID, so it is a plain string rather than format:uuid.
